newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakura leading recovery in bank sector shares.
newsitem.headline: Sakura leading recovery in bank sector shares.

text.p: A recovery in Sakura Bank Ltd share prices was leading an overall rebound in prices in the banking sector on Friday, brokers said.
Tokyo's key Nikkei 225 recovered partially by mid-afternoon trade, as active buying back of bank sector shares ahead of the weekend boosted the index.
As of 0440 GMT, the key index was down 109.51 points or 0.61 percent at 17,964.36, recovering from a tumble earlier in the afternoon to 17,556.40.
But the Nikkei 225 soon lost momentum and resumed its fall again. By 0514 GMT, the Nikkei was down 511.98 points at 17,561.89.
